name: Chat history, chat deleted
summary: After the delete: three chats, the count corrected, and a toast at the top of the frame. The nav survives here, unlike after a bulk delete.

looseEnds.title: The toast carries an Undo that is switched off
looseEnds.detail: The Toast component has an Action slot holding the word Undo. It is hidden in this frame, as it is in every other delete toast across Chat history and Memory — so no drawn state offers a way back from a delete, although the component is built for one.
looseEnds.ask: Is Undo in scope? If it is, it needs a window and a drawn state; if it is not, the slot should come off the component so it stops reading as available.

looseEnds.title: The row leaves with no transition drawn
looseEnds.detail: The deleted conversation is simply absent and the three below have moved up 64px. Nothing states whether the row collapses, fades, or is replaced on a reload.
looseEnds.ask: Specify the removal, since an Undo would have to put the row back the same way.

looseEnds.title: The pill group sits 4px further left here than on the same nav elsewhere
looseEnds.detail: Search and Select are the same two components throughout, but the group that holds them is 275 wide with an 8px gap on the History frames and 271 wide with a 4px gap on the Deleting frames and on Memory. Both end flush at x=369, so the difference shows up on the left edge.
looseEnds.ask: Pick one gap. 4px matches Memory, which a developer will build from the same component.
